edits.new: For a plan (m,c), Nadeko must select a contiguous subsegment containing exactly m pieces whose initial colour differs from c. She repaints precisely those m pieces to c; all other pieces are left unchanged. The score of the plan is the length of the longest eligible selected subsegment, or 0 if none exists.
